questions.question: Which storage service can be used as a low-cost option for hosting static websites?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 is designed to host static content and is a highly cost-effective and scalable solution for hosting static websites.

questions.question: Which Amazon EC2 instance pricing model can provide discounts of up to 90%?
questions.explanation: Spot instances allow you to bid on spare Amazon EC2 computing capacity at massive discounts of up to 90% compared to On-Demand pricing. They are ideal for flexible, interruptible workloads.

questions.question: What is the AWS customer responsible for according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
questions.explanation: Under the shared responsibility model, AWS manages the physical infrastructure and environmental security, but the customer is responsible for configuring and managing data encryption in transit and at rest.

questions.question: Which of the following AWS Cloud services can be used to run a customer-managed relational database?
questions.explanation: Hosting a database on Amazon EC2 allows the customer full control over the database engine, operating system, patching, and configurations, unlike fully managed services like Amazon RDS.

questions.question: A company is looking for a scalable data warehouse solution. Which of the following AWS solutions would meet the company's needs?
questions.explanation: Amazon Redshift is a fast, scalable, fully managed data warehouse service that makes it simple and cost-effective to analyze all your data across your data warehouse and data lake.

questions.question: Which statement best describes Elastic Load Balancing?

options.text: It translates a domain name into an IP address using DNS.
It distributes incoming application traffic across one or more Amazon EC2 instances.
It collects metrics on connected Amazon EC2 instances.
It automatically adjusts the number of Amazon EC2 instances to support incoming traffic.

questions.explanation: Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets, such as Amazon EC2 instances, containers, and IP addresses.

questions.question: Which of the following are valid ways for a customer to interact with AWS services? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: AWS provides several primary ways to interact programmatically with its services: the AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) and Software Development Kits (SDKs).

questions.question: The AWS Cloud's multiple Regions are an example of:
questions.explanation: AWS Regions, along with Availability Zones and Edge Locations, make up the physical components of the AWS Global Infrastructure.

questions.question: Which of the following AWS services can be used to serve large amounts of online video content with the lowest possible latency? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 safely stores the raw video files, while Amazon CloudFront (a global Content Delivery Network) caches and delivers the content to end users with low latency.

questions.question: Web servers running on Amazon EC2 access a legacy application running in a corporate data center. What term would describe this model?
questions.explanation: A hybrid architecture seamlessly integrates and connects on-premises infrastructure (like a corporate data center) with cloud resources (like AWS EC2).

questions.question: What is the benefit of using AWS managed services, such as Amazon ElastiCache and Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS)?

options.text: They require the customer to monitor and replace failing instances.
They have better performance than customer-managed services.
They simplify patching and updating underlying OSs.
They do not require the customer to optimize instance type or size selections.

questions.explanation: AWS managed services alleviate operational burden by automating routine maintenance tasks such as hardware provisioning, database setup, automated backups, and OS patching.

questions.question: Which service provides a virtually unlimited amount of online highly durable object storage?
questions.explanation: Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) is a highly durable (11 9s of durability), virtually infinitely scalable object storage service.

questions.question: Which of the following Identity and Access Management (IAM) entities is associated with an access key ID and secret access key when using AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI)?
questions.explanation: Programmatic access to AWS resources using the CLI or SDKs relies on an Access Key ID and Secret Access Key, which are generated specifically for an IAM User.

questions.question: Which of the following security-related services does AWS offer? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: AWS Trusted Advisor includes a pillar specifically dedicated to identifying security vulnerabilities (like open ports), and AWS natively offers comprehensive data encryption tools (like AWS KMS).

questions.question: Which AWS managed service is used to host databases?
questions.explanation: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) is a managed service that makes it simple to set up, operate, and scale relational databases in the cloud.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides a simple and scalable shared file storage solution for use with Linux-based AWS and on-premises servers?
questions.explanation: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) provides a simple, scalable, elastic file system for Linux-based workloads that can be shared across multiple instances.

questions.question: When architecting cloud applications, which of the following are a key design principle?
questions.explanation: Implementing elasticity is a core cloud design principle. It ensures your architecture automatically provisions or terminates resources to match demand, avoiding paying for idle peak capacity.

questions.question: Which AWS service should be used for long-term, low-cost storage of data backups?
questions.explanation: Amazon S3 Glacier is an extremely low-cost storage class explicitly designed for data archiving and long-term backup where retrieval times of minutes to hours are acceptable.

questions.question: Which task is AWS responsible for in the shared responsibility model for security and compliance?

options.text: Granting access to individuals and services

questions.explanation: AWS is responsible for 'Security OF the Cloud,' which includes maintaining, patching, and updating the physical infrastructure and hypervisor layers, such as EC2 host firmware.

questions.question: Where should a company go to search software listings from independent software vendors to find, test, buy and deploy software that runs on AWS?
questions.explanation: AWS Marketplace is a curated digital catalog that makes it easy for organizations to discover, procure, and instantly deploy third-party software optimized to run on AWS.

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit of using the AWS Cloud?

options.text: Permissive security removes the administrative burden.
Ability to focus on revenue-generating activities.
Choice of specific cloud hardware vendors.

questions.explanation: By offloading undifferentiated heavy lifting (like managing data centers and physical servers) to AWS, a business can focus its time and resources entirely on revenue-generating activities.

questions.question: When performing a cost analysis that supports physical isolation of a customer workload, which compute hosting model should be accounted for in the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)?
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 Dedicated Hosts provide physical servers with EC2 instance capacity entirely dedicated to your use, meeting strict regulatory compliance and physical isolation requirements.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides the ability to manage infrastructure as code?
questions.explanation: AWS CloudFormation allows you to model, provision, and manage your AWS and third-party resources declaratively using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) templates.

questions.question: If a customer needs to audit the change management of AWS resources, which of the following AWS services should the customer use?
questions.explanation: AWS Config continually monitors and records your AWS resource configurations, enabling you to audit resource history and track change management.

questions.question: What is Amazon CloudWatch?

options.text: A code repository with customizable build and team commit features.
A metrics repository with customizable notification thresholds and channels.
A security configuration repository with threat analytics.
A rule repository of a web application firewall with automated vulnerability prevention features.

questions.explanation: Amazon CloudWatch is a monitoring service that collects operational data in the form of logs, metrics, and events, allowing you to set customizable alarms based on metric thresholds.

questions.question: Which service allows a company with multiple AWS accounts to combine its usage to obtain volume discounts?
questions.explanation: AWS Organizations features Consolidated Billing, which groups the usage from all connected accounts to qualify the organization for volume pricing discounts faster.

questions.question: Which of the following services could be used to deploy an application to servers running on-premises? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: Both AWS OpsWorks (which uses Chef/Puppet) and AWS CodeDeploy are capable of automating application deployments to Amazon EC2 instances as well as on-premises servers.

questions.question: Which Amazon EC2 pricing model adjusts based on supply and demand of EC2 instances?
questions.explanation: Spot Instance pricing fluctuates based on the current market supply and demand of spare computing capacity within an AWS Availability Zone.

questions.question: Which design principles for cloud architecture are recommended when re-architecting a large monolithic application? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: Modernizing a monolithic architecture involves breaking it into loosely coupled microservices and ensuring those independent components are designed to scale elasticity as demand changes.

questions.question: Which is the MINIMUM AWS Support plan that allows for one-hour target response time for support cases?
questions.explanation: The Business Support plan is the minimum tier that provides a < 1 hour target response time for production systems that are down.

questions.question: Where can AWS compliance and certification reports be downloaded?
questions.explanation: AWS Artifact provides on-demand access to AWS's security and compliance reports (such as SOC, PCI, and ISO certifications) and select online agreements.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides a customized view of the health of specific AWS services that power a customer's workloads running on AWS?
questions.explanation: Unlike the general Service Health Dashboard, the AWS Personal Health Dashboard provides alerts and remediation guidance specifically tailored to your active AWS resources and infrastructure.

questions.question: Which of the following is an advantage of consolidated billing on AWS?
questions.explanation: Consolidated billing aggregates usage across all linked accounts. Because AWS prices many services in volume tiers, this combined usage qualifies the organization for lower prices.

questions.question: Which of the following AWS features enables a user to launch a pre-configured Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) instance?
questions.explanation: An Amazon Machine Image (AMI) provides the underlying blueprint required to launch an instance, including the operating system, server configurations, and applications.

questions.question: How would an AWS customer easily apply common access controls to a large set of users?

options.text: Apply an IAM policy to an IAM group.
Apply an IAM policy to an IAM role.
Apply the same IAM policy to all IAM users with access to the same workload.
Apply an IAM policy to an Amazon Cognito user pool.

questions.explanation: An IAM Group allows you to specify permissions for multiple users at once. By attaching a policy to a group, any user added to that group automatically inherits its permissions.

questions.question: Which AWS Cost Management tool allows you to view the most granular data about your AWS bill?
questions.explanation: The AWS Cost and Usage Report (CUR) provides the most granular, comprehensive set of AWS cost and usage data, often broken down by the hour or resource ID.

questions.question: Which of the following can an AWS customer use to launch a new Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) cluster? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: An Amazon RDS instance can be launched interactively via the AWS Management Console or provisioned automatically as part of an infrastructure template using AWS CloudFormation.

questions.question: Which of the following is an AWS Cloud architecture design principle?
questions.explanation: Loose coupling ensures that IT components are independent. If one component fails, it doesn't cause a cascading failure that brings down the entire application.

questions.question: Which of the following security measures protect access to an AWS account? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Grant least privilege access to IAM users.
Create one IAM user and share with many developers and users.
Activate multi-factor authentication (MFA) for privileged users.

questions.explanation: Applying least privilege access prevents users from accidentally or maliciously accessing restricted data, while MFA provides an additional required verification step for account logins.

questions.question: Which service provides a hybrid storage service that enables on-premises applications to seamlessly use cloud storage?
questions.explanation: AWS Storage Gateway provides a hybrid cloud storage solution that bridges on-premises environments with cloud storage directly using standard storage protocols.

questions.question: Which of the following services falls under the responsibility of the customer to maintain operating system configuration, security patching, and networking?
questions.explanation: Amazon EC2 is an unmanaged, Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS) offering. The customer maintains full control and full responsibility for the guest operating system, including patching.

questions.question: Which of the following is an important architectural design principle when designing cloud applications?
questions.explanation: Deploying components across multiple Availability Zones provides high availability and fault tolerance, ensuring the application stays online even if an entire AZ fails.

questions.question: Which AWS support plan includes a dedicated Technical Account Manager?
questions.explanation: A designated Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a specialized concierge-level support feature exclusive to the AWS Enterprise Support plan.

questions.question: Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS) offers which of the following benefits over traditional database management?

options.text: AWS manages the data stored in Amazon RDS tables.
AWS manages the maintenance of the operating system.
AWS automatically scales up instance types on demand.

questions.explanation: Because Amazon RDS is a managed service, AWS handles undifferentiated heavy lifting tasks like database engine provisioning, backups, and maintaining/patching the underlying OS.

questions.question: Which service is best for storing common database query results, which helps to alleviate database access load?
questions.explanation: Amazon ElastiCache acts as an in-memory data store and cache, allowing you to temporarily store heavily accessed database query results to vastly improve response times and reduce database strain.

questions.question: Which of the following is a component of the shared responsibility model managed entirely by AWS?
questions.explanation: Under the shared responsibility model, AWS retains total control and responsibility over the physical security, environmental protection, and asset auditing of its global data centers.

questions.question: Which options does AWS make available for customers who want to learn about security in the cloud in an instructor-led setting? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: AWS offers both live virtual sessions (Online Tech Talks) and formal in-person or virtual training (Classroom Training) for interactive, instructor-led education.

questions.question: Which of the following features can be configured through the Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) Dashboard? (Select TWO.)
questions.explanation: Subnets and Security Groups are fundamental networking infrastructure components directly managed within the Amazon VPC interface.

questions.question: If each department within a company has its own AWS account, what is one way to enable consolidated billing?

options.text: Use AWS Budgets on each account to pay only to budget.
Contact AWS Support for a monthly bill.
Create an AWS Organization from the payer account and invite the other accounts to join.
Put all invoices into one Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) bucket, load data into Amazon Redshift, and then run a billing report.

questions.explanation: AWS Organizations enables you to group multiple independent AWS accounts under a single master payer account, automatically consolidating billing and sharing volume discounts.

questions.question: Which of the following steps should be taken by a customer when conducting penetration testing on AWS?
questions.explanation: Among the listed options, D is the best answer. Note the current AWS policy, though: customers may run penetration tests against eight permitted services (e.g., EC2, RDS, CloudFront, Aurora, API Gateway, Lambda, Lightsail, Elastic Beanstalk) WITHOUT prior approval. Approval is only required for tests outside that permitted scope or for network stress / simulated DDoS testing.
